name: pipe-run
why: The polyline sweep, against a closed form: three runs totalling 130 mm at r = 5, less the quarter Steinmetz solid each right-angle joint shares, plus the quarter ball neither run covers — 10138.64 mm3. Both backends read about 0.1% under it, which is the tessellation under-reading curved surfaces, and they agree with each other to 0.08%. A sweep along a spline has no exact field and is not offered; this one is a union of exact primitives, and the number is what says the joints neither double-count nor leave a gap.
